notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.content:
Dear friends! The year 2024 is coming to an end. And we are looking forward to the New Year 2025 with hope! Our team has done a lot of work in the past year. Very soon we will finally be able to announce our new game. And, as we hope, begin a new era in the history of N-Game Studios. We are looking forward to this moment! And we wish you all good health, prosperity, and great success in all your endeavors in the New Year - and, of course, cool new games. Including new games from our studio! We wish you to believe in miracles, friends, yourself, and the future! Stay with us. And Happy New Year!

notes.title: Anniversary discount!
notes.content: Hey folks! How quickly time flies! This May marks the 15th anniversary of the X-Team release. In honor of this event, for two weeks, the game will be available at a 50% discount. If you aren't yet familiar with our classic project and you like role-playing and strategy games - don't miss the chance to get acquainted with X-Team right now.

notes.title: Support Ukrainian people
notes.content:
War... War never changes. And most of all, ordinary civilians suffer from the war. N-Game Studios is one of the oldest game developers in Ukraine. For many years we have been making games for people all over the world. If you once liked Legends of Allods, Heroes of Might & Magic V, Frontline: Fields of Thunder, Towers of Oz, Blitzkrieg 3, Cossacks 3, and many others - this was part of our work too.

You know, there is a war in our country now. And it's you who can help ordinary civilians in Ukraine. To do this, just follow the link and buy our game X-Team at a special price of $50. The money raised in this way will be used to buy medicines, food, and other essentials. The more money you raise, the more people you will help.

Also, we turn to game sites, journalists, bloggers, YouTubers, etc. Please post this message on your resources. Maybe in this way, you will help save a few lives.

Sincerely,
your N-Game Studios team

notes.title: Autumn Sale
notes.content: For all fans of good old games. On the last day of summer, we offer you a 50% discount on our classic role-playing strategy X-TEAM! The game will be available for purchase at a discounted price from August 31 to September 7 inclusive. Don't miss this opportunity!

notes.title: Summer sales season
notes.content: Today the season of summer sales started on Steam started! This is a good opportunity to purchase many great games at a discounted price. Our classic role-playing strategy X-TEAM is also participating in this event! From June 25 to July 9, you can purchase the game with a 50% discount. Don't miss this chance!

notes.title: X-TEAM Birthday Sales!
notes.content: Hi folks! Twelve years ago, our classic X-Team project was released for the first time. We say “for the first time”, because then, in the spring of 2008, the game went on sale on CD-ROMs only in Russia and the CIS countries. Now the game is available on Steam, and you don't need to look for it on store shelves or download dubious pirated versions from torrents. Moreover, in honor of his birthday, X-Team will be available this week with a 50% discount. If you like role-playing and strategic projects, don't miss the chance to get acquainted with this unusual game!
